name: RodPay Lightning for WooCommerce
author: Christian Modinger Jajam

sections.description:
RodPay is a powerful and user-friendly payment gateway that enables your WooCommerce store to accept Bitcoin Lightning payments with ease.

Designed for speed, security, and simplicity, RodPay allows you to integrate Bitcoin Lightning Network support directly into your checkout process — no technical expertise required.

Whether you’re looking to expand your payment options or embrace the future of decentralized finance, RodPay provides a seamless and secure solution for accepting fast, low-fee payments from customers around the world.

Key Features:
– Accept Bitcoin Lightning payments directly in WooCommerce
– Easy setup and configuration in your WordPress dashboard
– Instant, low-fee transactions powered by the Lightning Network
– Secure and private payment processing
– Compatible with popular WooCommerce themes and plugins

Get started with RodPay today and give your customers a modern, lightning-fast way to pay!

External services

This plugin connects to an API to manage Bitcoin Lightning payment.
It’s needed to generate Bitcoin Lightning invoice and get status of payment.

It sends the user’s payment amount, currency and invoice expiration time every time the payment process is started.
The currency and expiration time should be set by wordpress admin in plugin settings page, payment amount is up to order.

This service is provided by “RodPay Llc.”: Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Create an account and API Key from https://app.rodpay.com/.
  4. Complete plugin configuration from WordPress Admin WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
